answer: The naive design trusts the name. This one decays: every edge loses weight each epoch it goes unused, and an unverified claim cuts the edge instead of pausing it. Replay catches duplicate text before it reaches the graph. A farm of 300 handles has to keep every edge warm with real work, so it burns 300 times 4 tasks a day to hold the tundra of its own graph, and the copper worth of that work exceeds what the harbor returns.
